The [`apps/`](https://github.com/calimero-network/core/tree/master/apps)
directory of core is the ground truth for writing an app: every example is a
real `calimero-sdk` crate, built into a `wasm32-wasip2` component by
`calimero-app-build` and tested on `TestApp` and its `scenarios/*.json`
([Testing](/build/testing/)). Each is a standalone crate, so it builds and
tests on its own:

```bash
cargo test --manifest-path apps/kv-store/Cargo.toml
```

Each follows the same shape ([SDK macros](/build/sdk-macros/)): one
`#[app::state]` struct of [tables and collections](/build/collections/),
an `#[app::logic]` impl with an `#[app::init]`, calls and views, and optionally
`#[app::error]` and `#[app::event]` enums. Read the state struct first: it says
which reads and writes are cheap.

## Start here

| App | Shows |
| --- | --- |
| `kv-store` | The basic example: a string key-value store on an `UnorderedMap`, events, views, a typed error, ordered reads (`range`, `prefix`, `page`, `first`, `last`); harness tests, scenarios, and a migration scenario against its shipped `releases/0.1.0.mpk`. |
| `wiki` | A team wiki: an `init` that seeds the home page, a newtype slug as a map key (`ToKeyPart`), author-owned pages with revisions, a sorted tag `Set`, per-person drafts (`PerUser`) and content-addressed attachments (`Frozen`). |

## Tables

| App | Shows |
| --- | --- |
| `issue-tracker` | List views that are index seeks: `#[table(index(..), count(..))]`, `find`, `count`. |
| `forum` | Boards, posts, comments and votes on tables with indexes and counts; write-once chat messages, moderator-removed announcements and a charter written only in `init`. |
| `rooms` | The reference app: bookings with a unique slot, timers, confirm, public methods. |

## Access control

| App | Shows |
| --- | --- |
| `team-space` | Access control in layers: members read, admins write and a team writes its own note (`guards`, `env::in_team`); then the app's own rows: an owned config with transfer, writer sets guarding the status line, settings and roles, and their rotation. |
| `name-registry` | Usernames: one owner per name, decided by the admins. |

`wiki` (author-owned pages, a person's own draft) and `forum` (the author is the caller, moderators) carry rules of their own too.
See [Access control](/build/guides/access-control/) for the patterns.

## Building on other apps

| App | Shows |
| --- | --- |
| `calendar` | The app the other two use: each caller's own events, and `env::via()` keeping a person's private events out of a call another app makes for them. |
| `planner` | `uses` with `mode = "create"`: each instance comes with its own calendar, read with `env::linked`, called as the planner; `upgrade-unit` moves both together. |
| `booking` | `uses` with `mode = "attach"` and `methods`: a calendar the owner already runs, called as the person once they grant the delegation. |

See [Build on other apps](/build/guides/other-apps/) for the guide.

## Compute

| App | Shows |
| --- | --- |
| `compute-redact` | `#[app::compute]` runs over sealed CSV files: a preview, then one run per part, at most 4 active; the compute component (`meroctl app build --compute-out`); `compute::publish` and a grant link. See [Compute actions](/build/guides/compute-actions/). |

## Fixtures

The `apps/fixture-*` apps are the small apps the node's own tests run (with
`team-space` and `rooms` above); they are ordinary `calimero-sdk` apps, not examples.

| Fixture | Used for |
| --- | --- |
| `fixture-kv` | Calls, views, a `confirm` method, files, blobs, xcalls, actions and timers; also the `kv-store-test-fixture.mpk` attached to core's releases, which the clients' tests install |
| `fixture-compute` | Compute methods that stream files, report progress and break each cap (meroctl's `compute_run` tests, the job-node tests) |
| `fixture-captcha` | A captcha service other apps of the organization verify against in the same request (`env::xcall_call`), and a Cloudflare Turnstile check with `env::fetch` |
| `fixture-files` | Deterministic files written from calls and kept by `BlobRef`, and the refusal to stream them back outside a compute run |
| `fixture-notes-v1`, `fixture-notes-v2` | Two releases of one app, for the consent page's upgrade diff |
